versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam i drugu pojavu povezanu s munjama: neke zvijezde izlaze, postaju munje i više se ne mogu rastati od svojega novog oblika.
